description: Source code for an AudioProcessor class that manages WebRTC audio processing, including buffer management, channel swapping, delay analysis, and integration with WebRTC's AudioProcessing module.

classes.name: AudioProcessorCaptureBus
classes.description: Wraps AudioBus to provide access to channel pointers for WebRTC processing.

classes.name: AudioProcessorCaptureFifo
classes.description: Manages FIFO buffer for audio frames, supports pushing and consuming audio data, handles channel and frame size adjustments.

methods.name: AudioProcessor::Create
methods.description: Factory method to create an AudioProcessor instance with WebRTC processing.

methods.name: AudioProcessor::ProcessCapturedAudio
methods.description: Processes incoming captured audio, manages FIFO, applies WebRTC processing, and invokes callback with processed audio.

methods.name: AudioProcessor::SetOutputWillBeMuted
methods.description: Sets mute state for output audio.

methods.name: AudioProcessor::OnStartDump
methods.description: Starts dumping WebRTC audio processing data to a file.

methods.name: AudioProcessor::OnStopDump
methods.description: Stops dumping WebRTC audio processing data.

methods.name: AudioProcessor::OnPlayoutData
methods.description: Handles playout audio data, updates delay estimates, and feeds data into WebRTC for reverse stream analysis.

methods.name: AudioProcessor::AnalyzePlayoutData
methods.description: Analyzes playout data for delay and error reporting.

methods.name: AudioProcessor::ProcessData
methods.description: Runs WebRTC stream processing on captured audio, manages volume, delay, and channel upmixing.

methods.name: AudioProcessor::SendLogMessage
methods.description: Logs messages with context about the AudioProcessor instance.

methods.name: AudioProcessor::ComputeInputFormat
methods.description: Computes appropriate input format for WebRTC processing based on device format and settings.

methods.name: AudioProcessor::GetDefaultOutputFormat
methods.description: Determines default output format, considering WebRTC processing requirements and input format.
